subject.title: [Feature]: Add Korean (ko) language support to Control UI and AI agent

question: Should OpenClaw add an agent-wide same-language response policy and automatic Korean-aware web-search defaults, or keep language control in existing per-channel/per-agent prompt surfaces?
rationale: The remaining request changes global agent and search behavior, and current policy evidence does not prove that a Korean-specific default is safer than existing per-channel prompts or per-call search language parameters.

options.title: Split policy work with proof
options.body: Keep this issue open only for a scoped maintainer-sponsored agent/search policy design backed by a current Korean transcript and focused tests.

options.title: Adopt global same-language defaults
options.body: Accept a core prompt/search behavior change and require tests for mixed-language, explicit-English, and Korean tool-use conversations before implementation.

options.title: Close as UI-only solved
options.body: Treat the shipped Control UI locale as the accepted scope and direct operators to existing channel or agent prompt surfaces for response-language preferences.

recommendation.title: Split policy work with proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open only for a scoped maintainer-sponsored agent/search policy design backed by a current Korean transcript and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The open decision is mainly about agent prompt and web-search behavior rather than the already-shipped UI locale pipeline.
